name: FlexInput Virtual Keyboard
notes: Plain-HID virtual keyboard (FunctionMode 0, no companion). Standard 8-byte boot-compatible report: [modifiers, reserved, key1..key6] (6KRO array, usage page 0x07). No Report ID; no LED output report (nothing consumes it -- the driver's output ring stays unused). The HOST (kbdhid) does typematic auto-repeat natively, so unlike the SendInput backend the writer never re-sends held keys. Reports are built directly by flexinput-virtual's keymouse_hm (NOT the gamepad PinState/encode path) and published via HidMaestroDevice::write_raw_input. VID 0x1209 is the pid.codes open-hardware space with an unregistered PID -- cosmetic only: the node is ROOT-enumerated (never on a USB bus) and deliberately does NOT use 045E or any gamepad-adjacent identity, so no xinputhid/GameInput/SDL heuristic can ever latch onto it (see xbox360.json for that saga).
